create_load_config: create a LoadConfig dataclass instance with specified load format and download directory
build_load_format_enum: build a LoadFormat enum value to specify model weight loading format like safetensors or pt
verify_load_format: verify the load format string is valid and converts it to a LoadFormat enum member
configure_modelopt_loading: configure ModelOpt checkpoint restore and save paths in a LoadConfig instance
setup_remote_instance_loading: setup remote instance weight loader with seed instance IP and service port in LoadConfig
